column1: # name<TAB>note (known differences between ga68 and a68j; used by tools/rosetta_report.py)

column2: libm: tan of a REAL rounds differently in glibc (tanf) than on the JVM ((float) Math.tan)
libm: sin/ln of REAL values round differently in glibc than on the JVM

evaluation order: in the assignation "IF ... FI := end OF queue := qnode" ga68 (GCC) elaborates the source before the destination, a68j the destination first, as Algol 68 Genie does, and gives its output; Algol 68 leaves the order open

ga68 defect not reproduced (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entry 10): ga68 gives "flex [1 : ulam_size] char ulam" the bounds [1 : 0], and the program stops with a bound error; a68j gives the bounds of the declarer and prints the Ulam numbers, as Algol 68 Genie does (tests/rosetta/fixed)

ga68 defect not reproduced (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entry 10): ga68 gives "flex [UPB target] char parent" the bounds [1 : 0], so the empty parent has the fitness 100 % at once; a68j gives the bounds of the declarer and evolves the string (tests/rosetta/fixed)

ga68 defect not reproduced (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entry 9): the constructors store routine texts in heap structures, and ga68 crashes (segmentation fault) when one is called after the constructor has returned; by Algol 68 the calls are valid (the routines use only their own parameters), and a68j prints what Algol 68 Genie prints (tests/rosetta/fixed)

scope violation: the routines that y yields use its parameters after it has returned; Algol 68 Genie stops with "F value is exported out of its scope", ga68 crashes (segmentation fault), a68j keeps the frame alive and prints the numbers

ga68 defect not reproduced (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entry 19): partial parametrization (in circle (0, 0, radius, , )), an Algol 68 Genie extension; ga68 compiles the calls with missing arguments and crashes, a68j prints what Algol 68 Genie prints (tests/rosetta/fixed, tests/partial)

ga68 defect not reproduced (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entry 9): the logical file end handler is a routine text inside a procedure that has returned when the handler is called; ga68 makes it a GCC nested function with a trampoline in the stack frame of that procedure, and the call jumps into the dead frame. By Algol 68 the call is valid (the routine uses only names of the outer range); a68j runs it as Algol 68 Genie does (tests/rosetta/fixed)

ga68 defect not reproduced (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entry 11): ga68 computes MODAB with the C remainder, so "sgi -:= 1 MODAB max_state" gives -1 and the program stops with a bound error; a68j computes MOD and prints the numbers of the task (tests/rosetta/fixed)

ga68 defect not reproduced (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entry 11): ga68 computes MODAB with the C remainder, so the 8-bit machine gives "***" for 0-255 and -1 for 0-1; a68j computes MOD and gives 1 and 255 (tests/rosetta/fixed)

ga68 defect not reproduced (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entry 3): NKTg1 overflows to an infinite REAL, for which float of libga68 does not end, so the native program times out; a68j prints asterisks for it
prints argv (1), the path of the executable, which differs natively and on the JVM

ga68 defect (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entries 4 and 5): a format writes wrong digits of a REAL (2.0**30, exactly 1073741824, as 1073741793.6); a68j writes the digits of the exact value, within the tolerance of run_jvm.py

ga68 defect (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entries 4 and 5): a format writes wrong digits of a REAL (2.0**30, exactly 1073741824, as 1073741793.6); a68j writes the digits of the exact value, within the tolerance of run_jvm.py
ga68 defect (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entries 4 and 5): a format writes wrong digits of a REAL; a68j writes the digits of the exact value, within the tolerance of run_jvm.py

ga68 defect (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entry 4): fixed writes wrong digits of a REAL (147116994 / 10000, the REAL 14711.69921875, as 14711.6994); a68j writes the digits of the exact value, within the tolerance of run_jvm.py

ga68 defect not reproduced (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entry 19): the generators use partial parametrization ((F fac, int n) int: ...)(fac, ), which ga68 compiles, and the program crashes (segmentation fault); a68j prints what Algol 68 Genie prints (tests/rosetta/fixed)
long long real has 80 bits in ga68 and 64 bits in a68j, so long long max real differs; ga68 also prints wrong last digits of max real and long max real (docs/ga68-bug-reports.md, entries 4 and 5)
